The '''1997–98''' season of the [[Belgian First Division A|Jupiler League]] was held between 8 August 1997 and 10 May 1998. [[Club Brugge]] became champions.

These teams were promoted from the [[Belgian Second Division|second division]] at the start of the season:
*[[K.S.K. Beveren|Beveren]] (second division champions)
*[[K.V.C. Westerlo|Westerlo]] (playoff winner)

==Relegated teams==
These teams were relegated to the second division at the end of the season:
*[[R.W.D. Molenbeek (1909)|RWDM]]
*[[R. Antwerp F.C.|Antwerp]]

==Brugge's title success==
Club Brugge ended in first place 18 points ahead of [[K.R.C. Genk|Racing Genk]].

==Battle for Europe==
[[R.S.C. Anderlecht|Sporting Anderlecht]] finally qualified for the [[UEFA Cup]] by ending in 4th place as Genk (2nd) and Brugge (1st) played the [[Belgian Cup|Cup]] final.  The third team to qualify for the UEFA Cup was [[K.F.C. Germinal Beerschot|Germinal Ekeren]] (3rd).

==The relegation dog fight==
RWDM was relegated following a 1-1 draw at [[R. Charleroi S.C.|Charleroi]] as the newcomer Beveren managed to draw against Germinal Ekeren on the 33rd matchday.  With 4 points more than RWDM the club from Waasland then lost to Anderlecht on the last matchday whereas RWDM easily beat [[K.S.C. Lokeren Oost-Vlaanderen|Lokeren]] by 5-1.
